title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Jailing
A gangbanger squares off with his victim's family in court and with another inmate inside the jail; the Kent County Jail staff must deal with a former colleague gone bad.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Hustle
Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Pain
One reality of prison is that there's never a shortage of pain, and at the Limon Correctional Facility in Colorado, there's enough left over for the visitors as well; drama unfolds as a father and son try to reconcile a violent past.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Keeper
An inmate with incredible artistic abilities is charged in tragic crime; another inmate's seeming obsession with jail food causes problems; an unconventional marriage ends violently.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E6 — SEG
Solitary confinement is one of the most common methods for disciplining inmates, but it's also a very controversial issue.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E3 — The Flip Side
A U.S. Marine violates the code and now faces a murder charge; a would-be soccer mom takes up with a violent street gang; an openly gay inmate adheres to the convict code and pays the price.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E4 — $udden Death; Hip Hop Hustle
A successful financial advisor's world crumbles under a multi-million dollar scam; a Chicago-area rapper convinces a local businessman that he's got a new gig that doesn't exist.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E16 — Wine, Women and Fraud
A man steals millions from rich wine clients, and spends the money on fast cars and faster hookups, until he himself falls prey to a scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E3 — The Prisoner of Wall Street
A man is convicted of wire fraud and money laundering after claiming to sell coffee futures.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — And Baby Makes Three?
Behind the razor wire topped fences and brick walls of the Kent County Jail an inmate worker deals with the pressure of trying to create the jail's most popular dish; a pair of incarcerated lovers might end up having another mouth to feed.
